title: Release Gate
prompt: Implement release_gate(pyproject_text, argv) that: (1) parses the TOML and raises ValueError('missing name') if [project].name is absent; (2) routes argv through a main-style dispatch: argv[0] == 'version' prints the version and returns 0; anything else returns 2 after printing an error to stderr; (3) if the dependencies list contains a bare (unpinned) name, raise ValueError('unpinned: <name>'). Return the dispatch exit code.

tests.name: valid project + version command
tests.code:
text = '[project]\nname = "t"\nversion = "1.0.0"\ndependencies = ["httpx>=0.27"]'
import io, contextlib
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    code = release_gate(text, ['version'])
assert code == 0 and buf.getvalue().strip() == '1.0.0'
tests.hint: Parse, verify, dispatch: 'version' prints the version, exit 0.

tests.name: missing name raises
tests.code:
text = '[project]\nversion = "1.0.0"'
try:
    release_gate(text, ['version'])
    failed = False
except ValueError as e:
    failed = 'missing name' in str(e)
assert failed

tests.name: unpinned dependency raises
tests.code:
text = '[project]\nname = "t"\nversion = "1.0.0"\ndependencies = ["requests"]'
try:
    release_gate(text, ['version'])
    failed = False
except ValueError as e:
    failed = 'unpinned: requests' in str(e)
assert failed
tests.hint: Every dependency must carry a constraint.

tests.name: unknown command exits 2 via stderr
tests.code:
text = '[project]\nname = "t"\nversion = "1.0.0"'
import io, contextlib
err = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
    code = release_gate(text, ['fly'])
assert code == 2 and err.getvalue().strip() != ''
tests.hint: Dispatch failures report to stderr with exit 2.
